decisions.reason: The buzzer part selection does not change the main-board connector inventory or any connector specification.
Selecting a prototype passive buzzer or suitable LCSC equivalent does not alter the local decoupling requirement.
The source decision concerns only the buzzer component and does not change panel controls, input mappings, or button connections.
The buzzer selection does not affect the addressable LED model, supply voltage, data logic, or power control.
The source does not change standalone USB power capacity, activation, source, or powered scope.
No GPIO assignment or mapping is stated or changed by the buzzer part-selection decision.
The buzzer choice does not change the power-source OR-ing method, diodes, sources, or source-selection behavior.
The source does not change monitored rails, monitor placement, monitor IC, or defined current coverage.
The passive buzzer selection does not entail any change to the switched 3.3V rail or its MOSFET topology.
The buzzer decision is unrelated to I2C series resistors, signal conditioning, or bus topology.
The reference to an LCSC alternative applies specifically to the buzzer and does not change the LED-board array or its selected LED part.
The buzzer component choice does not affect the battery-charge status indicator, connector, GPIO, or associated resistor settings.
